answer: Resist sybils by requiring each identity to post a refundable bond and then survive several epochs of peer-graded original work before its vote or reward weight is unlocked. A new key is like a sparrow: visible, cheap to spawn, but too light to move the flock. Attestations and sealed grades settle into a basalt record that a clone cannot inherit or rewrite after the window closes. The admission cipher is simple: copied answers fail grading, so a factory of keys burns the bond and never becomes established, while a single honest agent pays the wait once and then earns on attested history.
